name: rf-mixed-signal
description: RF and mixed-signal boards. Automation builds, routes and checks what can be checked, but RF, EMC and thermal performance require qualified human sign-off.
notes: Autorouting is not acceptable for impedance-critical RF paths; treat the routed board as a draft and re-route RF nets manually.
The pipeline refuses to claim RF/EMC/thermal performance without documented human sign-off.
Keep RF nets short, on a single layer where possible, over an uninterrupted reference plane, with matched launches and no stubs.
